items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: I bet he was brother to Buddy. Buddy Lloyd-Kaner.

ctx.x: What was Eddie Miller playing then? Tennis.

And did he play any clarinet or things? Fine. Nothing, nothing, nothing as good as Fodger. He played rap. I started clarinet kind of style of rap and he got a full rap. Well, one night, Eddie Miller was playing with a band by the name of Martin. They had four Millers in the band. Now, Benny Miller was playing the guitar, the little red guy. Eddie was playing saxophone clarinet. And Chuck Miller was playing the drums. And the little band was doing a carol. So, I went back there one night, Michael Manon, Louis…
Didn't you tell me that there was a lot of New Orleans musicians with the March of the Bobcat with Bob Crosby? Oh, I didn't know that.
